description: Source code for handling PCCH message types in 3GPP RRC NR protocol, including serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: pcch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Class representing the PCCH message type choice, with methods for setting and serializing the type.

classes.name: pcch_msg_type_c::c1_c_
classes.description: Nested class for handling specific options within the 'c1' choice of PCCH message type.

classes.name: pcch_msg_s
classes.description: Class representing the entire PCCH message sequence, with serialization and JSON conversion methods.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Sets the message type to 'c1' and returns reference to nested class.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to 'message class extension'.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the object to JSON format.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the object into bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the object from bit buffer.
